business_problem: Agricultural Bank of China needed to automate high-volume document and identity extraction across rural onboarding, credit and operations workflows where manual entry was slow, error-prone and expensive.
solution_summary: Agricultural Bank of China extended its Financial Brain program with an OCR intelligent-service cloud that standardizes document extraction across multiple business lines. The deployment uses a distributed, loosely coupled architecture under the bank's Financial Brain so OCR becomes a reusable capability rather than a point solution. Within that framework, Baidu OCR services cover general OCR, identity cards, bank cards, tables, business licenses and custom templates, enabling the bank to process both structured forms and mixed operational documents. The platform sits behind several production scenarios: rural users can register and bind cards faster through ID and face-recognition capture, credit officers can extract enterprise financial statements from large batches of forms, and operations teams can handle account opening, bill extraction and centralized processing with fewer manual steps. By folding OCR into Financial Brain's perception layer and unified access controls, the bank turned document understanding into a core service for smart banking rather than a one-off workflow tool.

solution_components.name: General OCR

solution_components.name: ID Card OCR
solution_components.role: Captures and parses identity information for onboarding and verification workflows.

solution_components.name: Bank Card OCR
solution_components.role: Reads bank-card information for account and payment workflows.

solution_components.name: Table OCR
solution_components.role: Extracts structured data from enterprise financial statements and other tables.

solution_components.name: Business License OCR
solution_components.role: Processes business-license information for enterprise workflows.

solution_components.name: Custom Template OCR
solution_components.role: Handles bank-specific forms and document layouts not covered by standard templates.

data_flow: Identity documents, cards, tables and bank forms are routed into the OCR intelligent-service cloud, where recognition services extract fields and return them to onboarding, credit, mobile-banking and operations workflows for downstream processing.
business_outcome: ABC improved recognition quality, cut document-entry effort and embedded OCR into a broad set of production banking scenarios, making smart-document handling part of its larger intelligent-bank architecture.
